messages:
amanda: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I'm consolidating owners/timelines for streaming/chat reliability fixes (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect logic). Pls ack and add ETAs.

raj: Ack. I'll take the reconnect backoff tuning and client SDK changes. ETA EOW for a prototype.

dina: I'll own server-side timeout surface (idle vs processing) + metrics. Need a week to run canary.

leo: I'll add observability panels (per-route streaming lat/p50/p95, reconnect rate, partial-response counts). ETA 3 working days.

marco: Support will own the post-deploy verification checklist and runbooks for on-call. Can have draft tomorrow.

opsbot: Incident ticket created: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 — priority P2. Linked: INF-4322 (metrics), INF-4323 (sdk).

amanda: Concrete action items (please paste a short ETA next to yours):
1) SDK reconnect/backoff defaults + docs — owner: raj
2) Server timeout classification + graceful-close semantics — owner: dina
3) Observability dashboards + alert thresholds — owner: leo
4) Post-deploy verification runbook & customer comms template — owner: marco
5) Add regression tests simulating partial responses & mid-stream disconnects — owner: jules
6) Add canary with degraded-model fallback (low-capacity path) — owner: product/kelly (coord)

raj: ETA: prototype by 2001238000 (end of week). Proposed defaults in SDK: max_retries=3, initial_backoff_ms=100, jitter=0.2. Will open PR early.

raj: Draft snippet I'll include in PR:
```yaml
reconnect:
  enabled: true
  max_retries: 3
  backoff_ms: [100, 300, 1000]
  jitter: 0.2
heartbeat_seconds: 15
```

jules: For regression tests I'm going to add a harness that simulates: mid-stream TCP close, delayed tokens, and truncated responses. ETA 6 days.

dina: For server timeouts, proposal: split idle_timeout vs processing_timeout and emit event tag 'partial_response:true' when connection closed after >0 tokens. Will instrument within 4 business days.

leo: Alerting proposal: fire when partial_response_rate > 0.5% over 5m for a stable route + reconnect_rate spike > 300% baseline. I'll add panels to the streaming service dashboard.

marco: I'll draft the on-call checklist: steps to validate backend, how to toggle canary fallback, and what to tell customers. Will have initial draft by 2001234700 (tomorrow).

kelly: I'll coordinate the canary policy and own the rollout gating criteria (error budget, latency SLOs). Can't lead implementation but will work with infra. ETA meeting tomorrow 10am.

amanda: Two cross-cutting risks: 1) default SDK changes may break older clients (need migration notes), 2) observability might miss signal if we don't tag partial vs abort consistently.

raj: Good call. I'll add a feature flag for the new defaults so we can flip per-customer.

dina: I'll standardize the event tag name and add a short JSON schema for logs so dashboards can rely on it.

opsbot: Reminder: weekly remediation sync scheduled every Tue 11:00; next one is 2001237200.

jules: One more ask — we should add a small fuzz test in CI that randomly injects reconnects during streaming e2e. Low cost, high signal.

leo: +1 for fuzz test. Will collaborate on dashboarding the fuzz runs.

marco: After the first canary, I'll run the verification checklist and post results back here with checklist items checked.

amanda: Thanks all. Please update INF-4321 with your ETA and any blockers. I'll compile status before the next remediation sync.

kelly: Acked. I'll post the gating criteria doc link in INF-4321 after the 10am meeting.

raj: PR opened for SDK defaults -> https://github.com/redwoodinc/sdk/pull/987 (draft). Need review from dina and jules on behavior.

dina: Will review PR tomorrow morning. Also adding unit tests around graceful-close.

jules: Will add CI fuzz job and a couple of deterministic regressions. ETA 6 days.

marco: Draft runbook posted in INF-4321 comments. Feedback welcome.

amanda: Closing note — objective for next sync: prototype SDK toggle live on canary, dashboards show baseline, and runbook validated. If we hit those three, we move to a broader rollout.

opsbot: This thread archived for follow-up.
